about.title: About
about.subtitle: Break The Pattern isn't one person. It's a standard.

blocks.d: Break The Pattern is a brand for repairs, web and tech others wrote off. A founder drives it today, but we build it as a team, not a name.
The pattern is settling for average. Slow service, generic templates, vague pricing. That's the pattern we break.
Because technical services can be fast, honest and excuse-free. Most aren't. We show it can be done differently.
Diagnosis first, then the fix. We understand the problem before we start solving it.
We're growing. More people, services and projects — but the standard stays the same. That's the whole point.

standards.d: We find the cause first. Only then do we talk price and timeline — and we hold them.
We use components we'll stand behind with a warranty. Not the cheapest substitutes.
Your device comes back cleaner than it arrived. A site is handed over so you can run it.

refuse: We don't use templates or page builders.
We don't promise deadlines we can't keep.
We don't bill for work that makes no sense.
We don't fit cheapest parts with no warranty.
about.future: BTP is growing from one person into a small team with a clear standard. Same honesty, more hands, more fields — from repairs to websites to harder technical work.
